final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sites.healtheval AS health_status, SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(CAST(scans.gbsize AS REAL) / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sites.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS overall_average FROM step1) SELECT step1.health_status, step1.total_scans, step1.avg_size_per_minute, step1.avg_size_per_minute - step2.overall_average FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_average IS NOT NULL
